> **Status: preliminary, no provisional default selected.**
> - Run on the interim public corpus (13.2B), not corpus A; `dynamic_audio_ctx=true` was not measured because it is broken in a long-running whisper-server v1.9.4 (06 §6.7).
> - Consequence for stage 1: the elimination rule assumes `audio_ctx` was tested, so `small`, `small-q5_1`, `medium-q5_0` and `large-v3-turbo-q5_0` were eliminated on full-window latency alone (small: p50 6.7 s, small-q5_1: 7.6 s — close to the 6 s limit and measured at up to 91–99 °C package temperature).
> - No configuration meets N2 (p90 ≤ 2.5 s even before injection). The fastest usable model is `small-q8_0` (p90 text_ready 5.65–5.82 s, WER 23.3 %). The 13.5 rule requires an explicit decision on the latency target; it is pending.
> - Observations: `small-q8_0` encodes faster than `small-q5_1` and f16 on this CPU (whisper-bench 5.0 s vs 7.0 s / 6.0 s); 8 threads give no gain (≤ 3 %); greedy decoding is deterministic here (WER spread 0.0 over 3 runs); beam 5 lowers `small-q8_0` WER from 23.3 % to 19.4 % at +33 % latency.

# Benchmark results

- Run: 2026-09-17T05:29:00+00:00; CPU: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8365U CPU @ 1.60GHz; governor: powersave; power: AC; kernel: 7.0.0-31-generic
- whisper.cpp: v1.9.4; dataset: `/home/leto/stt-corpus-public`; repeats: 3; decoding: `{"temperature": 0.0, "temperature_inc": 0.2, "language": "pl", "prompt": null, "rms_gate_dbfs": -50.0, "nice": 5}`
- text_ready_s = RMS gate + HTTP transcription + text normalization (excludes injection, capture finalization and queueing). **N2 is not confirmed by this report**: it requires `total` from the full daemon in v0.1 (13 §13.5).
- ⚠️ **Interim public corpus** (13.2B): other speakers and studio-like audio, not the user's microphone. Results are provisional; rerun on corpus A before fixing defaults.

## Provisional selection (13 §13.5, stage 0)

**No configuration meets p90 text_ready ≤ 2.5 s.** Best available compromises:
- fastest: `small-q8_0` t=8 actx=off greedy — WER 23.3 %, p90 5.65 s, RSS 461 MB
- most accurate: `small-q8_0` t=4 actx=off beam 5 — WER 19.4 %, p90 7.72 s, RSS 580 MB

Recommendation: N2 must not be changed silently; present these options and ask for an explicit decision on the latency target (13 §13.5).

Excluded configurations:

- `base-q5_1|t4|actx0|bs-1`: control model (not a production candidate)
- `base-q5_1|t8|actx0|bs-1`: control model (not a production candidate)
- `small-q8_0|t4|actx0|bs-1`: p90 text_ready 5.82 s > 2.5 s
- `small-q8_0|t4|actx0|bs5`: p90 text_ready 7.72 s > 2.5 s
- `small-q8_0|t8|actx0|bs-1`: p90 text_ready 5.65 s > 2.5 s
